generator_metadata.summary: 0-bg grid with: (a) exactly one color-1 cell (source anchor); (b) exactly one color-2 cell (destination anchor); (c) one or more shapes in colors other than {0, 1, 2} (e.g. one connected blob in some color, OR multiple separate cells). Rule: compute translation (dr, dc) = pos(2) - pos(1). On a FRESH 0-grid, for every non-{0,1,2} input cell at (r, c) with value v, paint (r + dr, c + dc) with v if in-bounds (else drop). The two anchor cells (1 and 2) do NOT appear in the output; only the translated non-anchor cells are kept.

review_brief:
# Review

Both assigned targets now have complete native parametric families with exact canonical defaults, meaningful input-dependent alternatives, deterministic 2–6 demonstration / 1–4 query generation, four distinct controller-side queries, current source inventories, protected-Racket authoring preflights, and source-bound counterfactual witnesses.

`6b6e3acc8a0a` adds a translated-pointer color selector that controls translated cargo. Its legacy single-test-pair canonical shape exposed a packet preflight iteration bug; the returned task-local compatibility runner normalizes only that shape and reuses the official validation path unchanged.

`616a5c01a7ea` adds a marker-row branch that controls the right-panel rotation. Its inherited tests were repaired to use portable packet helpers and semantic rule normalization instead of owner-layout paths and byte-format equality.

Focused source and copied-runtime tests pass, all eight bounded setting/seed authoring jobs pass protected-Racket execution, both causal ablations change final outputs, and the saved single-query projections pass public-byte and first-turn privacy checks. The largest lawful `616a5c01a7ea` strip is 9×29 because its width is `3n+2`; `6b6e3acc8a0a` reaches 30×30.

The return is reviewer-ready only. Exact integrated-source owner qualification, acceptance, and any training admission remain separate. Final review was a fresh author self-review because this environment provides no independent reviewer subagent.
